description: This file defines the Dispatcher class responsible for routing RPC messages to appropriate endpoints within Apache Spark's Netty RPC environment. It manages registration, message posting, and lifecycle of RPC endpoints.

classes.name: Dispatcher
classes.description: A message dispatcher responsible for routing RPC messages to endpoints, managing registration, and lifecycle within Spark's Netty RPC environment.

methods.name: registerRpcEndpoint
methods.description: Registers a new RPC endpoint with a given name and returns its reference.

methods.name: getRpcEndpointRef
methods.description: Retrieves the RpcEndpointRef for a given RpcEndpoint.

methods.name: removeRpcEndpointRef
methods.description: Removes the reference for a given RpcEndpoint.

methods.name: unregisterRpcEndpoint
methods.description: Unregisters an RPC endpoint by name, cleaning up associated message loop.

methods.name: postToAll
methods.description: Posts a message to all registered endpoints.

methods.name: postRemoteMessage
methods.description: Posts a message sent by a remote endpoint.

methods.name: postLocalMessage
methods.description: Posts a message sent by a local endpoint.

methods.name: postMessage
methods.description: Internal method to post a message to a specific endpoint with callback if stopped.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the dispatcher and all endpoints.

methods.name: awaitTermination
methods.description: Waits for dispatcher shutdown to complete.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Checks if an endpoint with the given name exists.
